EURUSD.label: EUR/USD
EURUSD.headline: Risk-context: net neutral EUR (-17)
EURUSD.sub_zh: 主导因素：趋势（特异）、套息（利差）。

GBPUSD.label: GBP/USD
GBPUSD.headline: Risk-context: net neutral GBP (+3)
GBPUSD.sub_zh: 主导因素：持仓（COT）、趋势（特异）。

USDJPY.label: USD/JPY
USDJPY.headline: Risk-context: net neutral JPY (+2)
USDJPY.sub: Led by positioning (cot), risk appetite. In the MoF intervention watch zone (~150–162); conviction capped.
USDJPY.sub_zh: 主导因素：持仓（COT）、风险偏好。 处于财务省干预观察区（约150–162）；信心受限。

USDCHF.label: USD/CHF
USDCHF.headline: Risk-context: net long CHF (+26)
USDCHF.sub: Led by carry (rate diff), trend (idiosyncratic). SNB has historically capped CHF (2015 floor gapped ~20%).
USDCHF.sub_zh: 主导因素：套息（利差）、趋势（特异）。 瑞士央行历史上设过下限（2015年跳空约20%）。

AUDUSD.label: AUD/USD
AUDUSD.headline: Risk-context: net neutral AUD (-12)
AUDUSD.sub_zh: 主导因素：持仓（COT）、趋势（特异）。

USDCAD.label: USD/CAD
USDCAD.headline: Risk-context: net neutral CAD (+4)
USDCAD.sub: Led by carry (rate diff), residual shock.
USDCAD.sub_zh: 主导因素：套息（利差）、残差冲击。

USDMXN.label: USD/MXN
USDMXN.headline: Risk-context: net neutral MXN (+17)
USDMXN.sub_zh: 主导因素：价格结构、持仓（COT）。

USDCNH.label: USD/CNH
USDCNH.headline: Risk-context: net neutral CNH (+15)
USDCNH.sub: Led by trend (idiosyncratic), risk index. Managed regime — the official fix sets the level; read as risk-context only.
USDCNH.sub_zh: 主导因素：趋势（特异）、风险指数。 受管理汇率 — 由中间价决定水平；仅作风险背景解读。

regime_thresholds.safety_driven: z >= 1 (positive residual — DXY up more than rates explain)
regime_thresholds.mixed: z <= -1 (negative residual — risk-appetite, DXY soft vs rates)
